generationInputs.prompt: A digitally drawn illustration in a clean, graphic, and expressive modern emoji style shows two yellow emojis with bold black outlines and flat, vibrant color fills. One emoji is standing behind the other emoji which is lying on its stomach on a bed. Both emojis have a round head with two large, expressive brown eyes with white highlights and black pupils. The standing emoji has eyes looking forward, and the emoji lying on its stomach has the back of its head visible and red circles on its cheeks. The standing emoji has thick, curved black eyebrows raised in a happy expression and a wide, curved black line indicating a smile. The standing emoji has two muscular arms bent upwards with closed, clenched fists, and the emoji lying on its stomach has two muscular arms extended outwards with open hands holding onto ropes. Below the torso, the standing emoji has two muscular legs with feet pointing outwards. Very thin black thong bottoms with bold black outlines are worn low on each emoji's body. The emoji lying on its stomach has a visible thinner waist and back and is lying on a simple, flat bed. There is subtle shading suggesting a surface below the standing emoji. Several white clouds and a lightning bolt are visible in the background.
